smoke case 1/2/3/4/5 (executed live): the pinned command is actually run via runSingleAllowlistedCommand (a real spawned node process, not a stub); refusals for selector-absent, exit!=0-but-pass-claimed, and intentRef-unresolved are asserted identically through verification_evidence_add and verification_evidence_batch_add. Additionally (F-006/F-007/F-008 post-round findings, same smoke, cases 8 and 12): a fresh executable-intent write with neither selector nor nonMechanicalReason is refused via both entry points (executable_intent_requires_selector_or_reason); a raw fabricated executable pass and a fabricated caller receipt via checklist_update (the third write path) are both refused; a legitimate re-persist preserves a real on-disk receipt.

smoke case 1 (receipt shape + independent sha256 recompute equality), case 2b (long-output tail-bound proof: outputTail truncated to 4000 chars while outputDigest covers the full 5000-char output; the finding F-002 mutation-kill regression is baked into this assertion), case 9 (result derivation overrides a caller-claimed 'fail' to 'pass' and derives 'pass' when result is omitted) — all executed live, all PASS.

smoke case 7 (executed live): an audited non-mechanical attestation against an executable intent is demoted to status=non_mechanical at buildVerificationCoverage with missingRequired=1; a hand-built mechanical:false fixture is likewise demoted; a hand-built legacy mechanical:undefined row still shows status=covered; a genuinely manual-typed intent's own attestation still covers itself.
